text: Requested by Sri (the owner). Rank requests that fix Athena itself (from the steward or Hestia: root-cause, repeated-failure, blind-spot and gate-review requests) ahead of feature and content work of the same priority in athena plan and drain. Website and study content requests from the steward are not fixes for this rule. Today 52 steward requests filed in the week to 14 Nov never ran because older feature items came first.
